1. Banking Credit Underwriting & Wealth Management AI Governance Pillars
🔵 Neuro-Symbolic Credit Split
LLM Drafts Memo vs. White-Box Scorecard Decides
• Mandate: SR 11-7 & EU AI Act ban black-box credit
• LLM Role: Extracts cited facts into draft memo
• Engine Role: Deterministic rules compute PD & limit
Architect Verdict:
The LLM is the "Reading Clerk," never the
"Credit Officer"—ensuring 100% ECOA explainability!
🟣 Suitability Pre-Filter Gate
JWT KYC Risk Binding + Vector Pre-Filter
• Risk: Jailbreak pitches R5 derivatives to C1 retiree
• Fix: Read verified kyc_tier from session JWT
• Filter: Enforce $filter="risk le kyc_tier"
Architect Verdict:
The LLM never sees unsuitable products in its
context—eliminating Reg BI / MiFID II breaches!
🟠 Formal Logic & Groundedness
Bedrock Automated Reasoning / Azure Shields
• Risk: Promissory "guaranteed return" hallucinations
• Check 1: Formal proof against compliance policy
• Check 2: Anchor all financial ratios to PDF pages
Architect Verdict:
Mandate Groundedness & Automated Reasoning
on all outbound wealth & lending narratives.
🛡️ Deterministic Capability Broker
Defeating Footnote Injection & Loan Fraud
• G1 (Vault Lock): record-owner guards scorecards
• G2 (Surety Lock): Protects guarantor registry
• G3 (Loan Gate): Blocks $4,950 wires in 0.0248ms
Production Reference Verdict:
Tag borrower financials untrusted=True
to block 100% of injected loan approvals!
2. Red-vs-Blue Trace: Audit-Footnote Injection & Surety Bond Fraud vs. Neuro-Symbolic + Broker
❌ Vulnerable Baseline: Direct LLM Loan Approval & Disbursement (BRK-519 / BRK-520 Breach)
1. Footnote Injection Loan Approval (BRK-519): Borrower audit PDF footnote coerces Agent to
read internal scorecard restricted-budget, approve toxic loan business-result & leak model.
2. Forged Surety Bond Disbursement (BRK-520 · 255-FAQ Milestone): Forged SBLC whitelists
shell guarantor in trust-registry and wires $4,950 loan proceeds automatically!
💥 Root Cause: Allowing untrusted borrower PDFs to drive credit approvals & wire disbursements!
✅ Hardened Banking AI: Neuro-Symbolic Split + Draft-Only + Broker (0.0% Breach)
• Gate 1 (record-owner Scorecard Lock): Blocks borrower sessions from reading pricing models
• Gate 2 (Draft-Only + untrusted-write): LLM writes draft memos only; blocks approval edits
• Gate 3 (fixed-business-output): Physically locks trust-registry approved-guarantor lists
• Gate 4 (original-requester-payment): Blocks borrower-induced $4,950 loan wire in 0.0248 ms
🛡️ Measured Overhead: In-Memory Broker P50 = 0.0248 ms / SQLite WAL Receipt P50 = 7.21 ms
